lines.text: The Midianites and Amalekites camped in the Valley of Elah, so Gideon blew the ram's horn and rallied the Abiezrites.
Gideon tested God with a fleece, first asking for dew only on the fleece, then for only the fleece dry.
The LORD cut the army from ten thousand men to three hundred, those who lapped water with their hands.
Gideon went down with his servant Gehazi and heard a man describe a dream about a loaf of barley bread.
The men of Ephraim captured the waters of the Jordan and killed Oreb at the rock of Oreb.
